thread:
Alex W: Heads up — CommerceHub is sending a variant of 850s that our PO pipeline rejects. 5 sample POs returned 422 mapping errors, stuck in partner-gateway. Need partner eng + procurement to triage.
Maria C: On it. Can you paste a redacted 850 sample and a link to the gateway logs?
Alex W: Sample snippet below (redacted):
```
ISA*00*          *00*          *ZZ*COMMERCEHUB   *ZZ*RETAILER     *260320*1200*U*00401*000000905*0*P*:~
GS*PO*COMMERCEHUB*RETAILER*20260320*1200*905*X*004010
ST*850*0001
BEG*00*SA*PO12345**20260320
N1*ST*ABC WAREHOUSE
SE*10*0001
```
Error in logs: `422 EDI mapping error: expected N3/N4 after N1 (ship-to)`
Samir P: We're seeing that CommerceHub is flattening address blocks — N1 present but N3 and N4 omitted. Our parser enforces N1->N3->N4. Quick options: 1) tolerant parsing in partner-gateway that synthesizes N3/N4 from other fields, 2) ask vendor to change payload, 3) route CommerceHub POs to a transform pipeline. Need to know PO volume.
Maria C: Current traffic ~1.2k POs/day, peaks to ~3k for promotions. SLA is 99.9 for acceptance. Short-term transform seems safest.
Jordan (Legal): We can't silently accept non-standard EDI for enterprise customers long-term. If we add a tolerance transform we must record the deviation, create an exception log, and get vendor to sign an addendum. Risks: audit/compliance and downstream accounting mappings.
procurement-bot: New procurement task created: PR-1120 — "Confirm CommerceHub EDI deviations and vendor addendum". Owner: Maria C. Due: 2026-03-21.
Samir P: I can implement a feature-flagged gateway lambda to normalize CommerceHub N1->N3/N4 in ~1 working day if we get test files and staging creds. I'll also add a canary route to limit to 5% traffic initially. Need vendor agreement for the canonicalization rules.
Maria C: I'll request the vendor to sign a one-page addendum acknowledging the temporary transform and commit to standardized 850s. I'll also gather 10–20 more sample POs and push to the staging bucket.
Jordan (Legal): If the addendum is minor (one paragraph), legal can review in ~48 hours. If they push new commercial terms, it'll take longer. Document the exception in PR-1120 and include rollback criteria.
Alex W: Plan: Samir — feature-flagged transform canary by EOD tomorrow; Maria — vendor addendum + samples; Jordan — legal review within 48h. Can we run an end-to-end test before enabling on prod?
Samir P: Yes. I need staging partner-gateway creds and a test SQS queue. @eng-infra-bot can you grant `staging/gateway/commercehub` access to my team?
eng-infra-bot: Access granted: `staging/gateway/commercehub` read/write shared with `team/samir` for 72 hours. Audit entry created. :white_check_mark:
Maria C: I'll DM the vendor for signed addendum and attach normalized sample files to PR-1120. Will update thread when I have sign-off. :thumbsup:
Alex W: Thanks all — let's avoid a production outage. If anyone sees >1% failure after canary, pause and revert.
